profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer at Microsoft | Systems Architecture | AI-Assisted Engineering
profile.summary: I'm a hands-on Principal Software Engineer at Microsoft, building the licensing and client platforms behind Microsoft 365 and Copilot. I turn ambiguous product goals into technical direction and align partner organizations through delivery. I also lead AI-assisted engineering initiatives within my organization, developing reusable skills, tooling, agents, and workflows to improve how we build software.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
Led licensing architecture for Microsoft 365 and Copilot, integrating entitlement checks across Office applications. Caught and resolved a critical pre-launch licensing defect before it reached customers.
- Designed SDK integrations bridging native Office clients and web acquisition experiences, enabling partner teams to deliver independently of core licensing engineering.
- Defined the enterprise licensing-modernization strategy adopted by the organization, aligning Windows engineering and activation partners on technical direction and follow-on roadmap priorities.
- Lead AI-assisted engineering initiatives within the organization, developing reusable skills, developer tooling, agents, and workflows to streamline coding and team processes. Built an AI-assisted code-review extension and coach engineers on validating AI-generated code.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineering Manager
positions.description:
Established licensing's vendor validation team and staged test strategy, closing immediate coverage gaps and supporting critical Microsoft 365 releases.
- Led client licensing engineering for Office and Copilot through multiple reorganizations, maintaining delivery of time-critical commitments while coaching engineers into new areas of ownership.
- Introduced shared design/test-plan and code-review practices, and transferred operational ownership to engineers to expand team capability.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
Architected and led the Office-wide experiment for a free desktop client, aligning partner teams on dynamic feature enablement and rollout. Delivered the first production experiment on schedule and enabled its transition to a new owning team.

- Architected a cross-platform push-notification service for Office clients to accelerate feature activation through platform-specific delivery pipelines.

- Integrated native/web authentication for Office's in-app commerce platform. Separate experiments increased direct-purchase rate 7.8% for unauthenticated users and 36.3% for expired education users.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Architected reusable native/web commerce integrations for Office with identity, checkout, and application partners. Separate experiments increased paid-subscription rate by 9% and delivered 650%+ more SMB seat adds than the flow without an SMB purchase option.
- Owned engineering for Office's in-app renewal platform, increasing renewal rate 9.5% and LTV 12.5%. The impact: 3,200+ additional renewals and $900K incremental customer lifetime value per month.
- Supported client rollout and experiment analysis for Office's in-app subscription trials, which increased trial-start rate 21%+, LTV 13%+, and activation rate 14%+.
- Led in-app commerce performance optimization, reducing P95 load time by 40%.
- Helped rescope a referral experiment to email forwarding after web redirects reduced customer lifetime value.

positions.title: Software Engineer 2
positions.description:
Led a seven-engineer client feature team as a primary architect and hands-on C++ contributor to Office's cloud-connected licensing transition.

The 2019 rollout reached 7M+ consumer subscribers and reduced licensing issues by more than 10%.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Worked to build, create, and deploy customer cloud environments for Watson Health Cloud

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Developed C/C++ systems software for IBM WebSphere DataPower, spanning Linux networking, process orchestration, virtualization, and firmware integration.

- Modernized the underlying networking architecture, exposing socket-level control for more flexible networking capabilities.

- Designed process orchestration and extensibility that enabled asynchronous communication and integration with external data providers.

- Integrated licensing and security capabilities involving multithreaded process control, hypervisor integration, domain isolation, and XML message passing.

positions.title: Extreme Blue Technical Intern
positions.description: Built a Java workload-placement advisor and datacenter simulator for topology-aware server deployment.

positions.title: Engineering Intern
positions.description: Developed C/C++ and assembly bootloaders for AVR and ST sensor microcontrollers using UART, SPI, and RF communications.

positions.title: IT Engineering Intern
positions.description: Developed Java and SQL tooling to measure internal-tool adoption.

positions.title: Genetics Research Technician
positions.description: - Performed Polymerase Chain Reactions, DNA replication, and DNA extraction as a lab technician

patents.title: Editing one or more text files from an editing session for an associated text file
patents.description: Co-inventor of a published patent application for editing related source files inline within an IDE, reducing context switching. U.S. application 14/754,227; published December 29, 2016.
